tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: Films showing at cinemas near a place on a day, ranked by how many nearby cinemas show them, with times, formats and booking links. Use for "what is on near X tonight" (window tonight). Give a place name or lat and lon.

tools.name: movie_showtimes
tools.description: Upcoming screenings of one film near a place (or where it is showing in a country when no place is given), with times, formats and booking links. Small spelling mistakes in the title are fine.

tools.name: cinema_schedule
tools.description: Everything showing at one cinema over one or more days, plus its screens and ticket prices where known.

tools.name: find_cinemas
tools.description: Cinemas near a place (with distance), or by name, optionally only those with IMAX, premium or comfort screens or of one chain.

tools.name: format_screenings
tools.description: Screenings in a format family near a place or nationwide: imax, premium (premium screens: IMAX, Dolby Cinema, ScreenX, 4DX, D-BOX, the chains' own large screens (iSense, MAXX, Superscreen, EPIC, Xtremescreen, Vmax and others), LuXX and 35mm or 70mm film prints), luxury (recliners, VIP), special (cla

tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Resolve a town, city or coordinates to the CinemaTimes area that covers it and list the nearest cinemas. Use to check coverage. A name in several countries answers the clear favourite and names the others, or comes back as a list to choose from when none leads: then pass country, or lat and lon.

tools.name: search
tools.description: One search box over films showing now, cinemas and places, across every live country.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
